summary.zh: 这一版没有新功能，全是修复。最显眼的是桌面端进程区的工具行：以前有一批工具只显示一句通用的「正在忙碌中」，插件工具的文案从写下那天起就没匹配过任何一次调用，失败的工具还会显示成功文案配一个失败图标，这三处都补齐了，完成和失败两档也改写成脱离上下文能独立读懂。Windows 上另一件事更实际：安装目录从父目录继承的孤立 AppContainer SID 会让 Chromium 的 GPU 沙箱起不来，反复崩溃后应用自动降到兼容模式就再也回不去，现在安装器和应用启动时都会修复这个权限并给一次恢复探测的机会，仍然崩溃的机器会被还原回原来的兼容模式。分叉出来的会话里，分叉之前的文件和资源链接重新能打开；同一个文件换一种大小写拼法登记不再多出一条记录。安全面上，插件配置文件、几处迁移产物和签名密钥目录都纳入了只属主可读写的范围，启动时会巡检并纠正存量。
summary.en: This release has no new features; it is all fixes. The most visible one is the tool lines in the desktop activity area: a batch of tools only ever showed a generic "working on it", the labels written for plugin tools had never once matched a real call, and a failed tool showed the success wording next to a failure icon. All three are fixed, and the done and failed wordings are rewritten to read on their own out of context. On Windows something more practical: an orphaned AppContainer SID inherited from a parent directory keeps Chromium's GPU sandbox from starting, and once repeated crashes push the app into compatibility mode it never comes back. The installer and the app startup now both repair that permission and grant one recovery probe; machines that still crash are restored to the compatibility mode they had. In forked sessions, files and resource links captured before the fork open again, and registering the same file under a different spelling of its case no longer creates a second entry. On the security side, plugin configuration files, several migration outputs and the signing key directory come under owner-only permissions, with existing files checked and corrected at startup.

title.zh: 进程区的工具行说清楚每个工具在做什么
title.en: Tool lines in the activity area now say what each tool is doing

summary.zh: 进程区每条工具调用的文案只有一个取值点，对不上就静默落到通用兜底「正在忙碌中」。此前有三处漏洞：一方工具漏配 9 个（文件、会话、subagent 回复与关闭、循环控制、素材落盘、频道读取上下文与回复转交）；插件工具注册时会被加上插件 id 前缀，而语言包里的键没带前缀，6 组插件文案从写下那天起就没匹配过任何一次调用；取文案时只传进行中和已完成两个相位，失败相位从未被渲染，失败的工具会显示成功文案配一个失败图标。三处都补齐了。
summary.en: Every tool line in the activity area resolves its wording through a single lookup, and anything that misses falls silently back to a generic "working on it". Three holes had opened up: nine first-party tools had no wording at all (file, session, subagent reply and close, loop control, materialize, channel read-context, reply and pass); plugin tools are registered under a plugin-id prefix while the language packs held unprefixed keys, so six sets of plugin wordings had never matched a single call since the day they were written; and the lookup only ever passed the running and done phases, so the failed phase was never rendered and a failed tool showed the success wording next to a failure icon. All three are closed.

details.zh: 插件工具改成先查带前缀的键，未命中落到插件兜底，不走「剥掉前缀再查一次」那条捷径：第三方插件里叫 read 或 write 的工具会直接撞上内置工具的文案。
details.en: Plugin tools now look up the prefixed key first and fall back to a plugin-generic wording, rather than taking the shortcut of stripping the prefix and looking again: a third-party plugin's own read or write tool would collide head-on with the built-in wording.

details.zh: 已完成和失败两档改成脱离上下文也能独立读懂。这两档会长期留在会话记录里，而单工具调用的行永不折叠，旁边没有任何东西能补出主语和宾语。
details.en: The done and failed wordings are rewritten to read on their own out of context. Those two stay in the transcript indefinitely, and a single tool call's line never collapses, so nothing beside it supplies the missing subject and object.

details.zh: 措辞上区分两类词：用户接触过的（loop、workflow、PDF）保留原名，内部实现命名（capabilities、materialize、read_context）换成用户感知得到的说法。
details.en: The wording separates two kinds of term: names you have actually met (loop, workflow, PDF) keep their own spelling, while internal implementation names (capabilities, materialize, read_context) are replaced by what you would perceive them as.

details.zh: subagent 在中文里此前有「子会话」「子代理」两种叫法指同一个东西，统一为 subagent；日韩沿用各自既有的音译；繁体中文里三条漏转的简体一并转繁。
details.en: Chinese had been calling the same thing by two different names for subagent; they are unified. Japanese and Korean keep their established transliterations, and three untranslated strings in Traditional Chinese are converted.

sources.title: fix(chat): tool line wordings now say what each tool is doing

title.zh: Windows 上因 GPU 沙箱起不来而降级的机器恢复硬件加速
title.en: Windows machines downgraded by a failing GPU sandbox recover hardware acceleration

summary.zh: 根因是安装目录从父目录继承了孤立的 AppContainer SID（electron/electron#51761），Chromium 的 GPU 沙箱因此起不来。反复崩溃后应用会自动降到兼容模式，然后一直留在那里，因为没有任何东西会去解除降级。现在安装器在每次安装和更新时给安装目录授予受限应用包的读取执行权限，应用启动时也做同一处修复，随后清掉自动降级状态，给一次恢复探测的机会；修复后仍然崩溃的机器会被还原回原来的兼容模式，不会陷入反复崩溃。
summary.en: The root cause is an orphaned AppContainer SID inherited from a parent directory (electron/electron#51761), which keeps Chromium's GPU sandbox from starting. Repeated crashes push the app into an automatic compatibility mode, and it stays there, because nothing ever lifts the downgrade. The installer now grants restricted-app-packages read and execute on the install directory on every install and update, the app applies the same grant at startup, and the automatic downgrade state is then cleared for one recovery probe. A machine that still crashes afterwards is restored to the compatibility mode it had, so it never falls into a crash loop.

details.zh: 安装器侧的授权是幂等的，失败不阻断安装；应用侧的修复按安装身份只做一次。
details.en: The installer-side grant is idempotent and non-fatal on failure; the app-side repair runs once per install identity.

details.zh: 修复排在 GPU 启动策略解析之前，所以同一次启动就能吃到效果，不需要先白启动一次。
details.en: The repair runs before the GPU startup policy is resolved, so it takes effect on the same launch rather than needing a throwaway one first.

sources.title: GPU acceleration stuck in compatibility mode on Windows
fix(gpu): heal the Windows install-dir sandbox ACE and probe GPU recovery
fix(desktop): run the install ACL heal before resolving the GPU startup policy
fix(installer): grant the restricted-app-packages ACE on the install directory
fix(gpu): add recovery primitives to the GPU startup state store

title.zh: 分叉会话里，分叉之前的文件和资源链接重新能打开
title.en: In forked sessions, files and resource links from before the fork open again

summary.zh: 分叉出来的会话会把父会话的文件 id 记成旧别名，但有几处查找只认当前 id：打开媒体查看器、文件引用去重、插件解析会话文件引用，以及转写里在分叉前捕获的资源链接。这些地方现在都会连同旧别名一起匹配（有记录路径时也一并比对），按 id 的兜底查找也收窄到所属会话内，让它的旧别名解析真正生效。
summary.en: A forked session records its parent's file ids as legacy aliases, but several lookups matched only the current id: opening the media viewer, deduplicating file references, a plugin resolving a session-file reference, and resource links captured in the transcript before the fork. All of them now match the aliases too (and recorded paths where available), and the by-id fallback is scoped to the owning session so its legacy resolution actually applies.

sources.title: fix(desktop): match session files through legacy ids in renderer lookups
fix(resources): resolve resource links through legacy session file ids

title.zh: 同一个文件换一种大小写拼法不再登记成两份
title.en: The same file under a different spelling of its case no longer registers twice

summary.zh: 会话文件去重比较的是保留调用方大小写的路径字符串，所以同一个文件换一种拼法再登记就会多出一条记录，带自己的 id 和读取授权。现在统一走共享的文件身份键：原生规范化，并在忽略大小写的平台上折叠大小写。已有条目保留原 id——去重能在任何拼法下找到并复用它们，磁盘上不改写任何东西。
summary.en: Session file deduplication compared realpath strings that preserve the caller's casing, so registering the same file under a different spelling created a second entry with its own id and read grant. Comparison now goes through the shared filesystem identity key: native canonicalization, case-folded where the platform ignores case. Existing entries keep their ids, since deduplication finds and reuses them under any spelling and nothing on disk is rewritten.

details.zh: 同一套规范化也收敛到了路径授权与包含关系的比较上，此前几个模块各带一份互有出入的私有实现。Windows 上短名（8.3）变体因此同样被视作同一个路径；POSIX 上的比较不变。
details.en: The same canonicalization is converged onto grant and containment comparisons, which several modules had been carrying slightly divergent private copies of. On Windows a short-name (8.3) variant is therefore treated as the same path; POSIX comparisons are unchanged.

sources.title: fix(session-files): compare file identity case-insensitively where the filesystem does
refactor(fs): converge path canonicalization on the shared link-aware primitives

title.zh: 插件配置、迁移产物和签名密钥目录纳入只属主可读写
title.en: Plugin configs, migration outputs and the signing key directory come under owner-only permissions

summary.zh: 上一版把凭证文件改成只有你自己能读写，这一版补齐覆盖面。插件配置文件可能存着连接器和第三方服务的密钥，现在与其它凭证走同一个只属主的写入方式。几处数据迁移在改写 agent 配置和模型文件时会先落一个默认权限的临时文件，崩溃在改名之前就会永久留下一份可读副本，这些写入也改走同一条路。签名密钥和授权记录所在的安全目录写下时本就是只属主，但之后没有任何东西纠正过它——备份恢复或复制数据目录带回来的宽松权限会一直留着，现在启动时的权限巡检会走一遍这棵树。
summary.en: The previous release made credential files readable only by you; this one fills in the coverage. Plugin configuration files can hold connector and third-party service credentials, and are now written with the same owner-only primitive as the other credential stores. Several data migrations rewrote agent configurations and provider model files through a plain temporary file with default permissions, where a crash before the rename would leave a readable copy behind indefinitely; those writes take the same route now. The security directory holding signing keys and grant records was already written owner-only, but nothing ever corrected it afterwards, so loose permissions reintroduced by a backup restore or a copied data directory stayed forever. The startup permission pass now walks that tree.

details.zh: 启动巡检还覆盖了按 agent 的配置备份（包括迁移检查点里的那些），以及 agent 配置旁边残留的临时副本。
details.en: The startup pass also covers the per-agent configuration backups, including those inside migration checkpoints, and any leftover temporary copy sitting next to an agent configuration.

details.zh: 插件那边只碰配置文件本身，插件数据目录的其余部分归别的所有者，保持原有权限。
details.en: On the plugin side only the configuration file itself is touched; the rest of a plugin's data directory belongs to other owners and keeps whatever modes it has.

sources.title: fix(plugins): write plugin configuration files through the owner-only store
fix(storage): bring the security key directory under the custody pass
fix(storage): write credential-bearing migration outputs owner-only
fix(storage): write the remaining credential migrations owner-only
fix(storage): broaden the startup custody pass and the persistence scan

title.zh: 英文插件指南补齐三节，provider 兼容层参考重写
title.en: Three sections added to the English plugin guide, provider-compat reference rewritten

summary.zh: 英文插件指南缺了中文指南已有的三节：Agent 辅助开发流程、开发场景、诊断面板。翻译前先对着当前代码核验了它们描述的 API，现在两份指南都是同样的 13 个顶层章节。provider 兼容层的参考文档还在把这一层描述成 JavaScript，12 个相对链接全部指向不存在的文件，模块表只列了目录里 19 个文件中的 8 个——Kimi、LongCat、OpenRouter、Anthropic 这些看起来像是压根没有兼容层。链接全部修正，模块按分发实际遍历的顺序列全，并把与 provider 无关的辅助函数拆成单独一张表。
summary.en: The English plugin guide was missing three sections the Chinese one already had: the agent-assisted development loop, development scenarios, and the diagnostics panel. The APIs they document were verified against the current code before translating, and both guides now carry the same 13 top-level sections. The provider-compat reference still described that layer as JavaScript, so all twelve of its relative links resolved to nothing, and its module table listed only 8 of the 19 files in the directory, making providers such as Kimi, LongCat, OpenRouter and Anthropic look like they had no compat layer at all. The links are corrected, every module is listed in the order dispatch actually walks them, and the provider-agnostic helpers are split into a table of their own.

sources.title: docs: refresh provider-compat reference and sync English plugin guide
